title: Component census — per-task demand-side coverage (.cache/figma/reports/census-<stem>.json)
description: Output of scripts/component-census.mjs: each distinct owning design identity instanced on a task's screens (.cache/figma/screens/<stem>/*.instances.json) classified against the published Design Component Inventory and the project-owned Component Mapping Registry. Transient artifact (.cache/figma/reports/* is gitignored) — regenerated by every figma:screens pull / task-prep Step 5.5 / orchestrator Step 1b run. Consumers branch on missing/incomplete (task-prep splits), ambiguous/source-stale/retired (task-prep asks), and the per-identity rows (planner/builders use the MAPPED implementations).

gatePolicyVersion.description: OPTIONAL envelope field (see report-envelope.schema.json): the gate-policy version stamped by report-utils at write time

mappingConsult.description: the consult record behind inputHashes['virtual:component-mappings-consulted']: the owning design node ids this census consulted and the digest over their projections against the live truth (inventory presence, mapping state, per-implementation resolvability incl. source readability). evidence-bundle recomputes the digest from setIds + the live truth — a consulted identity changing still blocks the final gate; an unrelated edit does not

screens.description: screen name -> the owning design node ids instanced on it (duplicates preserved, in document order)

setNodeId.description: the owning component-set (or standalone main component) node id — the durable identity of this row

setName.description: display label only; two rows may share it

designComponentId.description: the resolved design identity; null when the current inventory does not know this node (SOURCE_STALE)

sourceNodeUrl.description: deep link to the sample instance's own node — for citing a MISSING component's node in the split

implementations.description: MAPPED only — the verified implementation resolution per platform

candidates.description: AMBIGUOUS only — the active mapping ids that claim this identity

retiredMappingIds.description: RETIRED only — the retired mappings the screens still depend on

codeCandidates.description: MISSING only — unmapped top-level non-private @Composable functions whose normalized name EXACTLY matches this label (bounded to 3): the reuse-or-create signal that turns task-prep's auto-split into a human pick

reuseCandidates.description: the subset of `missing` that carries codeCandidates — identities needing a reuse-or-create human pick before any split
